# Editorial parity fixtures

This directory contains frozen DATA fixtures. Python generators and donor copies have been removed; JSON, CSV, XML, hashes and oracle outputs are preserved byte for byte. TypeScript tests continue to compare against these expectations.

The historical module paths, SHA-256 values and Git revisions are recorded in the [fixture origin index](../../README-fixtures.md). Existing provenance inventories retain their historical Python entries; they are not a current checkout file list.

The published rebuild copies `data/inputs/editorial/{glossary,guide}.json`.
These snapshots are described inputs, not a recovery of the missing original
editorial sources. Their registered hashes and commit/blob provenance are in
`provenance.json` and `data/sources.yaml`; see `docs/reproducibility.md`.
The original `guide_raw.txt` is absent. `synthetic-guide.txt` is invented test
content solely for exercising the parser; it is not presented as that source.
`synthetic-guide-crlf.txt` is the same synthetic content with CRLF line endings;
its expected output was generated by Python reading it in text mode.
The historical glossary source and the route catalogue are frozen separately.

The expectations are a historical Python 3.12 capture.

The historical script ran the Python builders and verified
the registered snapshot hashes. The required test uses only these frozen inputs
and writes `EDITORIAL_PARITY_REPORT` when set. To compare the candidate to the
current checkout's release and route catalogue, run `pnpm editorial:compare-live`;
this is a separate local check, not a required CI gate.
